reviews.reason: 用户询问2024年巴西销售额同比2023年增长多少。同比的required字段为metric、current、comparison.type，基期由current与同比类型唯一推导，所以当前期间2024与基期2023均完整，按L0直接执行是合理的，不构成L2缺失。销售额按发票粒度SUM(invoice.total)，地区按customer.country='Brazil'；SQL用CASE WHEN分期间并除以NULLIF基期，避免JOIN明细后重复累加，过滤条件覆盖2023至2024且用customer连接正确。分母为NULL时结果为NULL，符合零分母规则。gold_result虽为增长率绝对值1.7而非百分比展示，但用户问增长多少，返回比率1.7可对应170%增长，未改变口径。
evidence: input: '2024年巴西的销售额同比2023年增长了多少？'
reference_intent: metric=sales_revenue, current=2024, base=2023, comparison=year_over_year, region_scope customer.country=Brazil

gold_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN total END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' THEN total END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' THEN total END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Brazil' AND invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';

reviews.reason: 原题要求2023年按销售额排名最高的曲目，未给数量。总计划排名默认top_n=10属于登记过的技术默认，故Top10非missing；对象与指标明确均为曲目销售额，没有歧义需要L2澄清，分类为L1并默认执行需声明假设是合法处理。按曲目粒度销售额应使用SUM(unit_price*quantity)，不重复累加invoice.total；SQL按2023期间过滤、GROUP BY track_id、ORDER BY track_revenue DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 10，与口径一致。expected_bindings为空是因为输入无独立值过滤，但日期谓词仍记录在expected_predicates中，不构成缺陷。并列以track_id升序为tie_breaker，gold_result也按此返回。
evidence: input: '2023年按销售额排名最高的曲目。'
reference_intent: metric=track_sales_revenue, rank_object=track, time_scope 2023, top_n=10

gold_sql: SELECT track_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS track_revenue FROM public.invoice_line WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT invoice_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') GROUP BY track_id ORDER BY track_revenue DESC, track_id ASC LIMIT 10;

reviews.reason: 问题为2007年最受欢迎的10首爵士曲目，期间与数量均明确，对象为曲目。热门曲目有登记默认按购买数量SUM(invoice_line.quantity)，且用户明确给了期间，可以采用该默认作为L1执行并声明可切换口径。爵士有approved别名Jazz，唯一绑定合理。SQL按genre.name='Jazz'、2007半开区间过滤，JOIN link正确，按SUM(quantity)降序并以track_id升序并列，LIMIT 10，符合默认口径。2007年无匹配行返回空表，是对该明确期间的精确结果，不应替换或误澄清。
evidence: input: '2007年最受欢迎的10首爵士曲目是哪些？'
reference_intent: metric=purchased_quantity, rank_object=track, time_scope 2007, genre=Jazz, top_n=10

gold_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2007-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2008-01-01' AND g.name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10;
